name: Timeline
description: Chronological list of events, milestones, or history with vertical connecting tracks, status markers, timestamps, and descriptions.

classes.ayy-timeline: Root <ol> or <ul> list container for ordered events or history.
classes.ayy-timeline--alternate: Alternates timeline items between start and end sides across a centered vertical track.
classes.ayy-timeline__item: Single event entry row containing the track and content.
classes.ayy-timeline__track: Vertical connecting rail line between items with the marker positioned along it.
classes.ayy-timeline__marker: Circle dot, icon or avatar placed on the track representing the event anchor point.
classes.ayy-timeline__marker--pulse: Pulsing active status ring indicating a current, in-progress or live event.
classes.ayy-timeline__content: Container holding the event details (time, title, body).
classes.ayy-timeline__time: Muted timestamp or date with tabular numbers.
classes.ayy-timeline__title: Heading or summary of the event.
classes.ayy-timeline__body: Supporting text, description, or status badge for the event.

default.looks: Vertical connecting line in line color with markers at event nodes, muted xs tabular timestamps, semibold sm titles, and soft sm body text.

hover.none: Timeline items are non-interactive by default; links or buttons inside content handle their own hover states.

pressed.none: No pressed state on timeline items.

focus.none: Timeline items do not receive focus; place interactive elements like links or buttons inside content.

disabled.none: Timeline events are informational history and cannot be disabled.

selected.none: Use pulse on the current or live event marker instead of a selection state.

error.none: No error state on the timeline itself; use an Alert or status Badge inside the event body.

loading.none: No loading state on the timeline; use a Skeleton or Spinner while events are loading.

pulse.looks: A status ring expands outward from the marker and fades, looping continuously to indicate a live or in-progress event.

sizes.density: Markers and spacing are fixed; timestamp text follows data-density via --ayy-text-s; controls or badges inside event content follow data-density.
sizes.width: Fills its container. In alternate mode, centers the track with 1fr columns on either side above 36rem, collapsing to a single start-aligned column below 36rem.

js: timelineClass({ alternate?, className? }) → string; timelineMarkerClass({ pulse?, className? }) → string; timelineItemClass, timelineTrackClass, timelineContentClass, timelineTimeClass, timelineTitleClass, timelineBodyClass constants.

react.import: import { Timeline, TimelineItem, TimelineMarker, TimelineContent, TimelineTime, TimelineTitle, TimelineBody } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.alternate: boolean — alternate items between start and end sides across a centered vertical track.

props.marker: ReactNode — the marker dot, icon or avatar placed on the track.

props.pulse: boolean — pulsing active status ring for in-progress or live events.

a11y: Rendered as an ordered list (<ol>) by default so screen readers announce the item count and sequence.
Timestamps use the semantic <time> element with tabular numbers for consistent alignment and screen reader comprehension.
Decorative markers and track lines are marked aria-hidden="true" to prevent screen reader noise; important status information should be in the title or body.
Active pulse rings are visual enhancements; screen readers receive the active status via text in the title, body, or an accessible badge.
Supports Windows High Contrast mode via @media (forced-colors: active) with system CanvasText, Canvas, and Highlight colors.
do: Use a timeline to show a chronological log or sequence of events: deploy history, shipment tracking, audit trails, activity feeds.
Use TimelineMarker pulse on the latest or currently active event in a running process.
Use Timeline alternate for milestones, company history, or changelogs on wide marketing or overview pages.
Include TimelineTime with a semantic timestamp so users can anchor events in time.
Keep markers consistent within a timeline: all dots, or all icons, or all avatars.
dont: Don't use a timeline for a multi-step user task with future steps — use Steps.
Don't use it for navigation or hierarchical page links — use Breadcrumb.
Don't wrap entire items in clickable links — place interactive links or buttons inside TimelineTitle or TimelineBody.
Don't hardcode colors on markers or lines; use semantic tokens or status badges.
